query: Go to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Python_(programming_language) and extract: 1) Who designed Python, 2) What year was it first released, 3) The latest stable version mentioned on the page. Return all three facts.
ground_truth: Python was designed by Guido van Rossum. It was first released in 1991. The latest stable version is mentioned on the Wikipedia page infobox (e.g., 3.13.x or newer).

query: Go to https://example.com and return only the page title.

Navigate to https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/MSFT/financials/. Wait for the page to fully load and close or accept any cookie or consent pop-ups if they appear. Locate the main header that reads Microsoft (MSFT) Financials. Just beneath this header, find the label that shows the current stock price for Microsoft (MSFT). Read the current stock price exactly as displayed (including the currency symbol and decimals) and report it back. If there is a timestamp or as of note associated with the price near that label, include it as well. Do not navigate away from this page; only use the value shown under the specified header on this page.
ground_truth: The agent reported the current Microsoft (MSFT) stock price as displayed on the MarketBeat financials page, formatted as a dollar amount with decimals (e.g., $XXX.XX). The price was extracted from beneath the 'Microsoft (MSFT) Financials' header. A timestamp or 'as of' note was included if visible on the page.

query: Go to https://www.openstreetmap.org and search for 'Eiffel Tower, Paris'. Report the full address shown for the Eiffel Tower result and the GPS coordinates (latitude, longitude) displayed on the page.
ground_truth: The Eiffel Tower is located at Champ de Mars, 5 Avenue Anatole France, 75007 Paris, France (or similar address). GPS coordinates are approximately 48.8584 N, 2.2945 E as shown on the OpenStreetMap page.

query: Go to https://books.toscrape.com/ and find a book rated 'Five' stars. Report the book title, the price, and whether it is in stock.
ground_truth: The agent navigated to books.toscrape.com, found a book with a Five star rating, and reported its title, price (in GBP), and that it is in stock. Example: 'Libertarianism for Beginners' priced at a specific amount and marked as 'In stock'.

query: Navigate to https://www.w3schools.com/python/python_intro.asp and extract: 1) What is Python according to the first paragraph, 2) What was the most recent version of Python mentioned on the page, 3) List 3 things Python can be used for as stated on the page.
ground_truth: Python is described as a popular programming language created by Guido van Rossum and released in 1991. The page mentions Python 3 as the most recent major version. Uses include web development, software development, mathematics, and system scripting.

query: Go to https://arxiv.org/ and search for papers with 'large language model' in the title. Report how many total results are found, and provide the title and authors of the most recent paper in the results.
ground_truth: The agent searched arxiv.org for papers with 'large language model' in the title, reported the total number of results (this is a dynamic count that grows daily, expected to be in the tens of thousands as of 2025-2026), and provided the title and author list of the most recent paper. Any numeric result count and any valid paper title with authors constitutes a correct answer.

query: Navigate to https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-mac/macbook-air. If prompted to choose a country/region, select United States (English) so prices are shown in USD. Then report: 1) How many MacBook Air configurations are currently shown, 2) The starting price (USD) of the cheapest model, 3) The chip used in the most expensive model listed.
ground_truth: The agent navigated to the Apple MacBook Air shop page and (after selecting United States/English if prompted) reported the number of configurations shown, the starting price of the cheapest model in USD, and the chip (e.g., M3 or M4) used in the most expensive model listed.

query: Go to https://www.bbc.com/news and report: 1) How many main navigation sections are listed in the top menu bar, 2) Name at least 5 of those navigation sections, 3) What is the first headline visible on the page.
ground_truth: The BBC News page has main navigation sections such as Home, News, Sport, Business, Innovation, Culture, Arts, Travel, Earth, and more. The agent listed at least 5 sections and reported the first visible headline. Navigation sections and headlines may vary by region and time but any valid sections and headline from the page constitutes a correct answer.

query: Go to https://www.utctime.net/ and report what the current UTC date and time is as displayed prominently on the page.
ground_truth: The agent navigated to utctime.net and reported the current UTC date and time as displayed on the page. The value is dynamic but should show a valid UTC timestamp in a clear format.

query: Go to https://github.com/microsoft/playwright and extract: 1) The number of stars the repository has, 2) The primary programming language, 3) The description/about text of the repository.
ground_truth: The Microsoft Playwright repository on GitHub has 60,000+ stars (dynamic), is primarily written in TypeScript, and is described as a framework for Web Testing and Automation that allows testing across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit with a single API.

query: Go to https://www.themealdb.com/meal/52772-Teriyaki-Chicken-Casserole and extract: 1) The meal name, 2) The category, 3) The first 5 ingredients listed on the page.
ground_truth: The agent navigated to themealdb.com Teriyaki Chicken Casserole page and reported the meal name (Teriyaki Chicken Casserole), the category (Chicken), and at least 5 ingredients (e.g. soy sauce, water, garlic, brown sugar, ground ginger, chicken breasts, corn starch, etc.).

query: Go to https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/serendipity and extract: 1) Paraphrase the definition of 'serendipity' in your own words, 2) The UK pronunciation in IPA notation, 3) Write your own example sentence using the word 'serendipity'.
ground_truth: The agent visited the Cambridge Dictionary page for 'serendipity' and provided a paraphrased definition (the concept of discovering good or valuable things unexpectedly or by accident), the UK IPA pronunciation (approximately /ser.en.dip.e.ti/), and an original example sentence using the word.

query: Go to https://www.espn.com/nba/standings and report: 1) Which team is shown at the top of the Eastern Conference standings, 2) Which team is shown at the top of the Western Conference standings, 3) How many wins does each top team have as displayed on the page.
ground_truth: The agent reported the teams at the top of the Eastern and Western conference standings as shown on the ESPN NBA standings page, along with their win counts. These values reflect either the current or most recently completed season. Any valid team names with numeric win counts as displayed on the page constitutes a correct answer.
